description: This Java class 'JwtService' provides functionality for creating, parsing, and validating JSON Web Tokens (JWTs). It is part of a security package and uses the io.jsonwebtoken library along with Spring framework annotations to manage JWT-based authentication.

classes.name: JwtService
classes.description: A Spring service class responsible for generating, parsing, and validating JWT tokens with configurable secret and expiration time.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT token for a given username and set of roles with an expiration time.

methods.name: extractUsername
methods.description: Extracts the username (subject) from the JWT token.

methods.name: extractRoles
methods.description: Retrieves the list of roles embedded in the JWT token claims.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if the token is valid by verifying the username and expiration date.

methods.name: parseClaims
methods.description: Parses the JWT token to retrieve claim data, throws exception if invalid.
